# pidginhost_floating_ipv6 (Resource)

A floating IPv6 address that can move between servers. Allow a server to use it with `pidginhost_floating_ip_authorization`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_floating_ipv6" "vip" {
  label       = "web-vip"
  reverse_dns = "www.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `label` (String) Label, up to 64 characters. **The API cannot change the label of an existing floating IP, so changing it replaces the floating IP and its address changes.**
- `reverse_dns` (String) Reverse DNS (PTR) name. Can be changed in place. When omitted, the API's default is kept.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The floating address.
- `authorized_server_count` (Number) Number of servers authorized to use the address.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway for the address.
- `id` (String) Floating IP ID.
- `prefix` (Number) Prefix length.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a floating IPv6 address by its ID.
terraform import pidginhost_floating_ipv6.vip 123
```
